scope: stream_event_probe_v2 static gates; no GPU activity; no files changed in frozen probe
decision: safe to collect diagnostics after freeze; not eligible for cost calibration

findings.issue: Positive event envelope alone is accepted even when vastly longer than enclosing host wall. Mutation of first row event_envelope_ms to 1e9 passed assess on valid fixture. Both timers cover begin-record to backend wait; gross disagreement signals invalid evidence.
findings.action: Before treating data as calibration, add preregistered coarse containment sanity bound with timing resolution tolerance; retain original outputs.

findings.issue: Loads full_raw_audit and assessments by status but does not verify present raw hashes against audit rows or rederive assessment from raw. A post-audit edit can leave summary falsely complete.
findings.action: Bind summary to raw digest records and protocol/manifest digest; preferably re-audit current raw before acceptance.

findings.issue: Any nonempty compute-apps list is labeled background graphics, not classified. Exclusive access correctly remains false, so this is diagnostic only.
findings.action: Do not infer idle/exclusive timing from endpoint snapshots or low dispersion; inspect process identities when interpreting timings.
